steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: This... this is...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island supply crates, yes. With dates and serial numbers.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The last time we made contact, it was me who...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What caused the fire?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: An accident... At least, that's what we decided at first, but...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Dr. Atro would never be so careless as to leave flammables lying around. All the signs point to this being caused by someone's Arts.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: We couldn't figure out where the fire started. The tent's metal support frame melted, and the bodies...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's fine. Continue.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Judging from the remains, the victims couldn't even leave the tent. There was no struggle. And of course, they were completely unrecognizable.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I don't think an ordinary fire could just incinerate Dr. Atro and her patients like that.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: It would have to be some form of Originium Arts that could achieve such high temperatures so quickly...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How many of them were Infected?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Hm? Oh... three from our village: Kevin, Biederman, and Eckehard were receiving treatment. And there was also...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Thor... Thorwald.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: He was the only son of the Schultz. And my friend. He wasn't Infected. He just went there to help, out of the kindness of his own heart.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Just let it out, Miss Tatjana. You need to get it off your chest.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I can sense the pain here.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Here... there was a lot of discontent here. Much joy, much pain. But it's all gone now.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Is that... is that an Originium Art?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No. I've just seen this kind of thing so many times. Everyone wants to keep their feelings bottled up inside. But it's not healthy.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Maybe I'm wrong. But if you treat yourself like that, you'll worry the people who care about you, no?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You should cry. Cry it all out. No one will judge you.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: You're right. Thank you. I already knew that, in a way, but for now I can't... I just can't let it go.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hm—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Don't. Don't look at me, Lisa. I get it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hm!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: *Sigh*... Now, I'm sorry!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh? What's that about...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...I thought I had prepared myself mentally back on the Rhodes Island landship. Atro was a very dedicated doctor. She always reported in on time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course I know what it means to lose contact with an operator. Rhodes Island has said goodbye to so many. I just couldn't get myself to believe it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I... I let my emotions get the better of me. And I'm sorry.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But we're not the only ones to lose somebody to this act of murder.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz Severin found the remains of eight individuals.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Since there are no Infected experts in our town, we can only hastily bury them...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: We can't let them stay with Wolumonde. They'll be buried in the wasteland outside the town. And when Wolumonde leaves, they'll lose their hometown forever.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Of course... in keeping with our traditions... we should do better than that, at least...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: This sort of thing happens a lot.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You said there were eight?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Yes. The five I just mentioned, and the others should be some wanderers who came seeking treatment.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: When the Great Rift came, Wolumonde didn't escape unscathed, and of course many merchants and travelers nearby got caught up in the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Things were bad for Wolumonde, but there was nothing else those people could do but chase down the town slowly crawling across the wasteland.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The look of the refugees coming in started to change... But Dr. Atro treated everyone equally. She even rescued some of the Infected. At least the ones who would accept the help.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That means one non-infected and seven Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What about the Infected remains? Within minutes to hours of the cessation of vital signs, depending on the rate of Originium assimilation in the body, there is a risk of secondary spread. It's very dangerous if not handled appropriately.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh, right, well, the Schultz decided that because they were only lightly infected, and with the rapid incineration of tissue, there wasn't much risk.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Didn't you say you had no Infected experts?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh, Schultz Severin just said he was going off of experience, and couldn't be absolutely sure.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Experience, huh...? What kind of job gives you experience handling Infected corpses...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But anyway, if he can keep his cool even after losing his own flesh and blood, maybe he takes his job more seriously than I thought.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I would like to inspect the Infected remains... I need to see Atro myself.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Yes, of course. I'll explain it to the Schultz. But most of the remains are charred so badly that we can't tell who was who.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No problem, I—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ah—!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Lisa?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That badge...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wow... it's Atro's employee badge. It survived...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh. Right.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She always complained it got in the way of her work. Isn't that funny? Just wear it on your neck or your chest. How could it get in the way...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let's go. I want to see her...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What was that sound?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: It's coming from the town!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: M-Miss Folinic! Someone's coming!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: That symbol. It's... Rhodes Island...? When did you get here...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And with your outfit... you're no ordinary Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Are you Leithanian? Or the Sarkaz they were talking about?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They're some armed Infected partisans who showed up outside the town recently. It looks like a group of Sarkaz make up the core, but they've taken in a lot of our local Infected.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The call themselves... the 'Mudrock Squad.'
